item.title: From vision to delivery: building Europe’s tokenised financial market
item.speaker: Piero Cipollone

rating.summary: ECB Executive Board member Piero Cipollone delivered a speech focused on the development of a tokenised financial market in Europe, outlining progress on the Eurosystem's Pontes and Appia projects. The speech covers digital asset infrastructure, DLT interoperability, legal frameworks, and public-private cooperation needed to build an integrated European capital market. There is no substantive discussion of interest rates, inflation, or monetary policy stance.
rating.stance_rationale: This speech is entirely about payments innovation, tokenisation, and financial market infrastructure rather than monetary policy. It does not contain signals about the ECB's rate path or easing/tightening bias.
key_quotes: Pontes will turn our commitment to provide central bank money for settling tokenised transactions into an operational service.
Appia paves the way for a single European market for tokenised assets, but we have not predetermined what the architecture for that will actually look like.
